item.title: Zelenskyy says he'd accept nuclear weapons from UK, France 'with pleasure'
item.description: Ukraine's president said no such proposals had been made, but added he would consider the offer, after Moscow accused UK and France of seeking to equip Kiev with a nuclear bomb.

item.title: Trump orders US government to cease using Anthropic following Pentagon's feud with AI firm
item.description: Washington gave AI startup until Friday afternoon to agree to unconditional military use of its technology — even where that clashes with the company's own ethical standards.

item.title: US backs Pakistan's 'right to defend itself' against interim Afghan Taliban government
item.description: State Department official Allison Hooker says, "We expressed support for Pakistan's right to defend itself" while President Trump praises Islamabad for "doing terrifically well."

item.title: Iran agreed in talks with US not to stockpile enriched uranium — Oman
item.description: Muscat's Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi says all issues in US-Iran nuclear deal could be resolved "amicably and comprehensively" within three months.

item.title: US designates Iran 'state sponsor of wrongful detention', potentially leading to travel ban
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says Tehran "must stop taking hostages and release all Americans unjustly detained in Iran."

item.title: Paramount acquires Warner Bros. in $110B mega-merger
item.description: Paramount Skydance acquires Warner Bros. Discovery in deal, ending bidding contest for owner of HBO Max after Netflix walked away.

item.title: Casualties as Bolivia plane carrying cash crashes on cars
item.description: Cargo plane crashes shortly after takeoff in El Alto city, killing at least 15 people, official says.

item.title: Canada pulls staff from Tel Aviv, urges citizens to leave Iran amid security risks
item.description: Ottawa cites civil unrest, arbitrary detention risks and limited consular assistance in updated travel advisory.

item.title: OpenAI strikes Pentagon deal after Trump blacklists rival Anthropic
item.description: Industry debates AI ethics as Pentagon deploys OpenAI models with "safeguards" while Anthropic resists use for surveillance or autonomous weapons.

item.title: Israel launches attacks on Iran amid US talks
item.description: Israel declares a nationwide state of emergency after striking Iran amid nuclear talks with the United States.
